purpose: Select exactly one genuinely new Campaign046 mechanism after Campaign045 terminated, without opening any Campaign046 minute candidate value, comparison value, daily price, forward return, training fold, or 2024-2025 stress value.

candidate_design_catalog.reason: It measures how much adjacent within-half return-product energy belongs to opposite-sign pairs. No frozen factor uses a sign-symmetric magnitude-weighted reversal-energy share over the exact 236 adjacent-return pairs.
The terminal negative-return-absorption mechanism is directionally one-sided, amount-weighted, and conditions only on a negative return followed by a positive return.
Pure counts reopen terminal sign-run, bar-direction-continuity, and weak-order mechanisms and discard the return magnitudes that define the selected energy allocation.

Signed covariance and multi-minute variance aggregation reopen terminal diffusive-variation, five-minute-variance-ratio, and persistence families; the selected factor uses no centering, covariance, or return-sum aggregation.
Correlation of adjacent absolute returns is the terminal Campaign028 definition. The selected factor instead allocates absolute return-product energy by sign reversal versus continuation.
Lag one, both complete half sessions, exact zero, and the fixed 236-pair support are frozen once; no lag, subwindow, threshold, epsilon-sign, or parameter family is searched.
Campaign046 contains one raw close-return mechanism and no terminal value, fitted weight, filter, threshold, regime, or model.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_return_reversal_energy_share_236p
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A larger share of adjacent one-minute return-product energy reversing sign indicates stronger two-sided liquidity absorption and less propagation of one-minute inventory shocks, which may leave a more resilient price-discovery state from the next open through the third close.
selected_candidate.formula: Within each 120-close half, form 119 adjacent log returns and 118 adjacent return pairs (a,b). Pool both halves to 236 pairs. Let W=sum(abs(a*b)) over all pairs and O=sum(abs(a*b)) only where a*b<0. Return O/W.
selected_candidate.zero_semantics: retain every exact-zero return in fixed support; a zero product contributes zero to numerator and denominator and is never bridged
selected_candidate.denominator_semantics: W must be finite and strictly positive

decision.next_action: Complete a separate pre-value overlap audit against all 68 inherited comparisons plus terminal Campaign045, then freeze the exact 69-comparison no-return protocol.
